detail.title: Intex TITAN 3000 (D) | 2.2 Tower Speaker (300W Power & 10" Wooferx2)
detail.overview: Intex Titan 3000 (D) 2.2 Tower Speaker The Intex TITAN 3000 (D) 2.2 Tower Speaker is built to deliver a superior sound experience with its 300W power, 3-way speaker system, and noise-free audio. Equipped with dual UHF cordless microphones, RGB front lights, and a variety of connectivity options, this speaker is perfect for home parties, karaoke, or simply enjoying your favorite music. Record your audio directly to USB and enjoy dynamic bass from its 10-inch woofers. Its portability and modern features make it the ultimate audio solution for any setting.
features: 300W powerful sound with boosted bass for an immersive audio experience
Dual UHF cordless microphones for karaoke and wireless use
3-way tower speaker system for clear, dynamic sound
RGB front lights for enhanced aesthetic appeal
Noise-free sound system for crisp audio
Recording feature: REC from AUX, BT & FM to USB
25.4 cm (10 in) x 2 woofers for deep bass
Multimode playability with USB, AUX, FM, BT, MIC, and HDMI
Portable design for easy movement and setup
